fixed_controls.timestep_hash: sha256(sampled visual and action timestep tensors, including dtype/shape/raw bytes)

variants.route_definition: Q=0; action tokens directly attend reference tokens through the original MoT route; no contact planner, token, encoder, or auxiliary loss is active.

Run the same Q=12 planner modules for parameter/FLOP control, then discard every planner output. Contact queries must be completely absent from the action context; action tokens retain the original direct reference route. The present model cannot express this route with config alone.

The Q=12 contact planner and grouped loss run, but planner hidden/logits/semantics are all invisible to action; action retains direct reference attention. This decoupled auxiliary-only route is not implemented.

Action may read the Q=12 planner's raw 1024-D hidden states and may not attend reference tokens directly. The existing non-semantic Q-token path uses learned query tokens, not standalone planner hidden states, so it is not this control.

Action cannot attend reference tokens and reads only the continuous activated 22-D semantic tensor through the 22-to-action-width encoder; this is a compatibility control without an auditable finite semantic alphabet.

Action cannot attend reference tokens and reads only bit-exact canonical hard 22-D semantics through the 22-to-action-width encoder; non-finite inputs are rejected, every numeric zero is canonical positive zero rather than an extra signed-zero state, and action gradients use straight-through identity back to the planner.
The forward action-visible route is identical to hard_st, but the transported tensor is detached; only the explicit grouped contact loss can update the planner.
Merge known ground-truth fields with unknown predicted fields before canonical hard transport; action reads only the transported result. It cannot run until audited v1.1 labels and masks exist.
